// diagnostic

E0203

Move marker `^` used on a non-consuming parameter

What

Move marker `^` used on a non-consuming parameter

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use `^` only for a consuming parameter.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0203: tests/ui/browser_bidi/native_bidi_bad_method_arguments_stop_in_sema.stderr.

Error [jet.ValueTypeMismatch]: `subscribe` wants String (text) for argument 1, but this is Int (a whole number)
  --> tests/ui/browser_bidi/native_bidi_bad_method_arguments_stop_in_sema.jet:18:23
    |
 18 |     session.subscribe(1) ?? return
    |                       ^
 Why: Every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: Put the value in text with interpolation: "{x}"
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [jet.MoveMarkerNotAllowed]: A value was passed with the move marker `^` to a parameter that does not consume
  --> tests/ui/browser_bidi/native_bidi_bad_method_arguments_stop_in_sema.jet:39:24
    |
 39 |     session.subscribe(^event_name) ?? return
    |                        ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Only parameters declared with the move marker `^` accept a moved value at the call site
 Fix: Remove the move marker `^`, or declare the parameter with that marker to take ownership
